title: How to Get USDT Address & Buy USDT in MetaMask for Nexastore
subtitle: extension · USDT on Polygon · NexaStore Checkout
addressFormatNotes: Nexastore ONLY supports USDT payment for orders. EVM addresses start with '0x' (42 hex characters). The exact same address receives Tether (USDT) on Ethereum (ERC-20), Arbitrum, and Polygon.
safetyTips: NexaPay locks the amount to the app price. Send that exact USDT amount on Polygon only.
Nexastore exclusively accepts USDT — paying with other coins (ETH, BTC) will not credit your order.
Keep ~$3–$5 worth of ETH in your MetaMask wallet to pay Ethereum network gas fees.
Always verify the first 4 ('0x9E') and last 4 ('2B71') characters of Nexastore's payment address.
NEVER share your 12-word Secret Recovery Phrase with anyone, even Nexastore support.

steps.title: Open MetaMask & Check Network
steps.instruction: Click the MetaMask fox icon in your browser toolbar. Confirm your network is set to Ethereum Mainnet or the network specified at Nexastore checkout.
steps.narration: First, open your MetaMask extension and confirm you are on Ethereum Mainnet or the chain accepted for your Nexastore order.

steps.title: Copy Your USDT Receiving Address
steps.instruction: Click directly on your account name or address header to copy your public address to your clipboard for receiving USDT or store refunds.
steps.narration: Next, click your account address to copy it. This is your public receiving address where USDT can be deposited.

steps.title: Click 'Buy' to Purchase USDT In-Wallet
steps.instruction: Click the 'Buy' action button. Select USDT (Tether), enter your payment amount (e.g. $100 USD), and choose Debit/Credit Card or Apple Pay.
steps.narration: Now click the Buy button in MetaMask. Select Tether USDT and purchase the required amount using your credit card or Apple Pay.

steps.title: Verify Your USDT Asset Balance
steps.instruction: Return to your MetaMask home screen and check that your Tether (USDT) token balance has arrived and reflects your order amount.
steps.narration: Confirm your USDT balance is loaded in your asset list so you have enough funds ready for your purchase.

steps.title: Pay Nexastore Checkout in USDT
steps.instruction: Go to Nexastore checkout, paste Nexastore's merchant USDT address (or scan their QR code), and send the exact order amount.
steps.narration: Finally, proceed to Nexastore checkout, enter the store's merchant USDT address, and approve the USDT payment.

steps.title: Open the paid app on NexaStore
steps.instruction: In NexaStore, open the app you want and tap Install / the USDT price button. Sign in if asked.
steps.narration: Open NexaStore, pick your app, and tap the buy or install button that shows the USDT price.

steps.title: NexaPay checkout opens
steps.instruction: The NexaPay widget shows the exact USDT amount locked to the app price. Confirm it matches the price on the store listing.
steps.narration: NexaPay opens with the exact amount the developer set. That amount is locked — you cannot change it.

steps.title: Continue to payment
steps.instruction: Enter your email for the receipt if needed, then tap Continue to payment. You will see the Polygon wallet address and QR code.
steps.narration: Tap continue to payment. NexaPay shows the receiving wallet address and QR code for USDT on Polygon.

steps.title: Send USDT on Polygon only
steps.instruction: From your wallet, send exactly the shown amount in USDT on the Polygon network to the address or QR. Other networks will lose funds.
steps.narration: Open your wallet, switch to Polygon, and send exactly that USDT amount. Do not use Ethereum mainnet or Tron.

steps.title: Wait for confirmation and download
steps.instruction: NexaPay waits for the on-chain payment. When it confirms, NexaStore unlocks the app and starts the download automatically.
steps.narration: After the payment confirms on Polygon, NexaStore unlocks the app and your download begins.
